Its Iridium Metallic exterior gives the vehicle a deep, polished gray finish that looks both modern and upscale. This color highlights the Acadias sculpted body lines and pairs perfectly with the chrome accents found throughout the exterior, giving it a clean and sophisticated appearance from every angle.

The front of the Acadia features a bold grille design with distinctive headlights that create a confident and recognizable look. The SLT-2 trim adds extra visual appeal with larger alloy wheels and subtle design enhancements that elevate its overall presence. Despite its midsize proportions, the Acadia maintains a sleek profile that makes it easy to drive and maneuver in both urban and suburban settings.

Under the hood, the 2019 Acadia SLT-2 is powered by a strong 3.6-liter V6 engine that provides smooth and responsive performance. It delivers plenty of power for highway driving, merging, and passing, while still maintaining a comfortable and composed ride. Paired with an automatic transmission, the driving experience feels steady and controlled, making it a great option for both daily commuting and longer road trips. Available all-wheel drive adds extra confidence by improving traction in different weather and road conditions.

It offers seating for up to seven passengers, making it a practical choice for families or anyone who needs extra space. The front seats are heated and power-adjustable, while the second row also provides added comfort for passengers, making longer drives more enjoyable.

Technology in the Acadia is straightforward and easy to use. The infotainment system features a touchscreen display with smartphone integration, allowing access to music, navigation, and apps. Bluetooth connectivity and multiple USB ports help keep everyone connected on the go.           Safety and Security
          • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
          • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

The 2019 Nissan Rogue Sport SV is the "Reliable Best Friend" of El Paso. Its the "just right" size for navigating a crowded UTEP parking lot, weaving through the Sunland Park Mall traffic, or finding that one open parallel spot downtown. Here is why this "Sporty" little number is a stealthy win for the Sun City! Don't let the name fool you it's not a race car, but its definitely nimble. The 2.0L DOHC engine is all about efficiency and ease. The CVT with Xtronic: Nissans signature transmission is designed to keep your RPMs in the sweet spot. While it won't win a drag race on Montana Ave, it offers a smooth, "rubber-band" feel that makes crawling through construction zones a lot less jerky. FWD (Front-Wheel Drive): Since we aren't exactly dealing with Seattle rainfall or Buffalo snow, FWD is perfect here. It keeps the car lighter and more fuel-efficient, saving you cash at the pump when gas prices spike. The Rogue Sport SV is the "Goldilocks" trim you get the features you actually need without the "luxury" price tag. The Size Factor: Its shorter and narrower than the standard Rogue. This is a massive win when you're trying to maneuver through a packed drive-thru at Chicos Tacos or fitting into a tight garage on the Westside. Dual-Zone Automatic Temperature Control: Because in El Paso, "I'm freezing" and "I'm melting" can be heard in the same car at the same time. The SV trim lets you both have your way.
Nissan Intelligent Key: With the El Paso sun beating down, the last thing you want to do is fumbling for keys. Keep them in your pocket, tap the door button, and get into that A/C ASAP. For a compact crossover, the Rogue Sport is secretly a pack mule thanks to the Divide-N-Hide Cargo System. The Grocery Hero: Heading to Vista Market or Albertsons? You can flip the floor panels to create shelves or hidden compartments so your gallons of milk don't roll around like bowling balls on the drive home.
Seating: Its got enough room for four friends to head to a Chihuahuas game without feeling like sardines. Navigating the I-10/US-54 interchange requires nerves of steel. The 2019 SV came with the Safety Shield 360 suite: Rear Automatic Braking: Great for those "oops" moments when someone leaves a shopping cart behind you at the Target parking lot. Blind Spot Warning: A total lifesaver for when those huge Texas-sized trucks decide to merge into your lane without looking. Buying a used car doesn't have to be a cause for worry. Casa fully inspects all the vehicles that make it to our lot, so we stand behind them. Your pre-owned vehicle is covered the moment you drive off the Casa lot. We understand that your vehicle is a significant investment, and we want to make sure that you get the most out of it. Caspian Blue Metallic 2019 Nissan Rogue Sport SV
